description: Inspect the document structure and apply formatting commands.

identity.goal: Complete the format document use case of wordcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the wordcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `wordcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced wordcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `wordcraft_inspect_document`, `wordcraft_list_commands`, `wordcraft_execute`, `wordcraft_render_page`. Steps: (1) Read the block structure. (2) Apply the formatting commands. (3) Render the page to check the result. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace wordcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
